description: The plot illustrates how loss ratio (in percent) varies with compute measured in TFLOPs for several model variants, with multiple colored lines overlaid for comparison. The x-axis is labeled “TFLOPs,” uses a linear scale, and shows tick labels from about 1e7 through 9e8 at roughly 1e8 intervals (with the first few ticks at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7 before 1e8). The y-axis is labeled “Loss Ratio (%)”, uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 94 to just above 100, with integer tick marks at 94, 95, 96, 97, 98, 99, and 100. The purple line with triangle markers (Vanilla) is a solid line that starts a little above 100% near 1e7 TFLOPs and increases gradually, remaining slightly above 100% toward the right end of the axis. The orange solid line (SepLLM (n=64)) rises from roughly 98.5% near 1e7 TFLOPs to around 100% by about 1e8 TFLOPs and then stays near or slightly above 100% through the highest TFLOPs shown. The blue line with x-shaped markers (SepLLM (n=128)) increases from about 97% at ~1e7 TFLOPs to around 100% by roughly 1e8 TFLOPs and then continues near 100% with a slight upward drift toward the right edge. The green line with diamond markers (SepLLM (n=64, H)) starts near 97.5–98% at ~1e7 TFLOPs, climbs to about 100% by around 1e8 TFLOPs, and remains around 100% thereafter with small upward changes at higher TFLOPs. The red line with circle markers (SepLLM (n=64, H/T)) begins near 94% at ~1e7 TFLOPs, increases steeply to about 98% by around 5e7 TFLOPs, reaches roughly 100% by about 2e8 TFLOPs, dips slightly near ~3e8 TFLOPs, and then returns to around 100% and stays close to that level through the largest TFLOPs.
